# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 6 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Satan Continues — His Refusal and Fall

---

**6:1** 'Michael urged all the angels: "Worship the image of the Lord God, as the Lord God has commanded." Michael worshiped first, then called to me: "Worship the image of God."'

**6:2** 'But I said: "I will not worship Adam." When Michael pressed me, I said: "Why do you force me? I will not worship one who is inferior to me and came after me. I am before that creature; I was made before him. He should worship me."'

**6:3** 'The other angels who heard my words also refused to worship him. Michael said to me: "Worship the image of God. But if you do not, the Lord God will be wrathful with you."'

**6:4** 'I said: "If he is wrathful with me, I will set my throne above the stars of heaven and make myself like the Most High."'

**6:5** 'The Lord God was wrathful with me and ordered me to be cast down from heaven with my angels.'

---
*SOPHIA: consensus rendering. Divergences logged in disagreement file.*
